response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and broad experience across languages and architectures, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT consulting, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for client-facing advisory work in Germany.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across diverse tech stacks (DLang, Node, TypeScript, Linux)
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops/educational content
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic (C1 required)
No clear evidence of architectural leadership or UML modeling in client consulting contexts
Lacks documented experience managing teams or overseeing multiple client projects simultaneously
